focus: Second-stage constructive repairs for the verified edge-PML linear-growth obstruction in the alpha=1 2D Maxwell-PML model: compatibility restrictions, shifted-variable/MPML damping, CFS or split-field models with monotone or uniformly bounded energy.

candidate_facts.claim_summary: For the constant x-edge magnetic-electric subsystem, after excluding the transverse zero mode, the simplified symbol factors as one damped mode and one undamped oscillator pair rather than a Jordan growth block.
Adding positive damping to the edge shifted magnetic variable gives a positive quadratic Lyapunov functional for the zero-mode H-M subsystem.

For arbitrary eight-variable edge-PML data in the original source equations, any monotone or uniformly bounded repair must either restrict the undamped shifted magnetic invariant or modify the PML memory dynamics.
